user_query: I need to process a document and extract text from it. Can you provide me with a list of OCR algorithms available? Also, check if the Aspose OCR Cloud storage exists and retrieve the list of files in the storage folder '/invoices'. Finally, recognize the document named 'receipt.jpg' using OCR and generate the output in PDF format.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of available OCR algorithms.
Check if the Aspose OCR Cloud storage exists.
Retrieve the list of files in the storage folder '/invoices'.
Recognize the document named 'receipt.jpg' using OCR.
Generate the output in PDF format from the recognized document.
